questions.stem: A graduate student is preparing a presentation on protein folding and the role of molecular chaperones in maintaining cellular protein homeostasis. While researching, the student encounters various facts about chaperones but realizes one of the statements they've noted is incorrect. Which of the following statements about chaperones is FALSE?
